description: Interi is MIT-licensed open source. Dependencies must use one of these permissive, MIT-compatible licenses. Copyleft (GPL/LGPL/AGPL/MPL) is not allowed.

stb.reason: vcpkg port has no license metadata. Upstream nothings/stb is dual-licensed MIT or public domain (Unlicense); Interi takes it under MIT. Reviewed 2026-10-18.

directx-dxc.reason: vcpkg port has no license metadata. Upstream DirectXShaderCompiler LICENSE.TXT (v1.9.2602.24) is the University of Illinois/NCSA license, reviewed 2026-10-13. The prebuilt package also contains libdxil/dxil.dll, which Interi never links or ships: dxc only runs at build time to emit SPIR-V.

build_tools.directx-dxc: HLSL compiler run at build time (cmake/InteriShaders.cmake); its output is SPIR-V, no DXC code ships with Interi.
